paper_title: Tracking Dynamical Features via Continuation and Persistence
statement: We conclude by briefly discussing some directions for future work. In Step 2g of the Tracking Protocol, there is a canonical choice of S ′ . But, as there is no common isolating set for S and S ′ , we cannot presently say anything about the persistence of the Conley index from S to S ′ . Is it possible to compute the Conley index persistence here in a controlled way? Can we meaningfully compute persistence for a different choice of invariant set? Investigation and experiments are likely needed to determine the most practical course of action in this case.
